label: Combat Readability Build
description: Per-BP test contract for BP3 (M3B + M4A + M5 + Double-Click Release Engineering). Declares the tests + evidence + grading dimensions + observe fields + cargo modules + sweep rows + perf gates required for BP3 closure. M3B (replay viewer + debrief) closed in PR #15. M4A (readability + ACC-A floor) lands in this BP per the Roadmap V2 split. M5 (equipment/chassis/damage grammar) closes BP3.

fun_proof_scenarios.description: M4A readability proof on the dedicated m4a_micro_breach_readability scenario (reuses the M1.5 micro_breach world via milestone_override) at 200% UI scale + high contrast + reduced_motion + reduced_shake + reduced_flash + hold_to_confirm + key_remap_enabled. Drives walk → refused dig (out of range) → break wall → fire → reload → take damage so every HUD line (silhouette + module strip + stance + banner stack + tool-validity + captions) carries meaningful values.

supporting_scenarios.description: M4A act.settings.set live-update round-trip: drives ui_scale + high_contrast + captions + reduced_* on then off again to prove the engine's Settings can be patched mid-run and re-observed.

regression_scenarios.rationale: BP3 must not regress BP1's M1.5 fun slice. Re-run with the same seed at the same tick rate; final_sim_checksum must match the BP1 exemplar.
BP3 must not regress BP2's M2.5 fun slice. Re-run with the same seed at the same tick rate; final_sim_checksum must match the BP2 exemplar.

perf_gates.rationale: 60 Hz tick budget = 16.67 ms/tick frame budget; conservative gate at 8.33 ms (50% of frame). M4A is a HUD-only milestone — no new sim path. Banner + caption queues are O(buffer_size).
120 Hz tick budget = 8.33 ms/tick frame budget; conservative gate at 4.16 ms (50% of frame). Validated via dedicated --tick-rate-hz 120 cf-app run on the m4a scenario.
BP1 regression baseline: m1_actor_range at 60Hz + 120Hz must not regress vs prior BP closures.

Honest down-scope (audit fix 2026-05-10): the M4A perf gates verify the SIM tick budget at 60Hz + 120Hz on a 1280x720 window only. The roadmap's Steam Deck 800p/60, 1080p/60, and 4K/120 RENDER perf tiers are NOT directly verified by the M4A scenario because cf-app does not yet expose a `--window-resolution` flag and the render cost of cf-render-2d is dominated by Bevy/wgpu's per-fragment overhead at the configured window dimensions, not by M4A sim cost. The previous bp3.test_manifest.json overclaimed all three render tiers from a single 1280x720 run; this is the honest version.
perf_gates.owning_milestone: T-PERF (BP4+ when M5.5 / M5.6 introduce render-cost-sensitive systems)
perf_gates.verified_evidence: Sim tick perf at 60Hz + 120Hz is verified above; resolution-tier render perf is the open work.
